Auguste Comte, A General View of Positivism, translated by J. H. Bridges.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/auguste-comte/a-general-view-of-positivism/j-h-bridges

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Auguste Comte, the author, died 1857.
- J. H. Bridges, the translator and annotator, died 1906.
- Frederic Harrison, the writer of the preface, died 1923.

First publication of the text used: 1865, the English translation (SE colophon: 'A General View of Positivism was published in 1848 by Auguste Comte. It was translated from French in 1865 by J. H. Bridges.'; the Wikipedia article A General View of Positivism says it was first published in English in 1865)

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the edition's rights statement (quoted below) places the text in the US public domain. The English translation was first published in 1865, before 1931.
- Country of origin (United Kingdom): the facts do not name the place of first publication, so the country is taken from the translator's English nationality (Wikipedia, John Henry Bridges: an English physician, writer and translator), and the text is in English (en-GB). If the first publication was in the United States instead, the US rule settles the origin, because the text was first published before 1931. Copyright in the United Kingdom lasts life plus 70 years after the death of the last surviving person named above. The last to die did so in 1923, so the work entered the public domain there on 1 January 1994.
- Original work (France, 1848): Auguste Comte died in 1857 (Wikidata Q12718, citizenship France). French life plus 70 years ended on 31 December 1927, so the original entered the French public domain on 1 January 1928. No person named above died after 1937, so the French wartime extension does not apply.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."

Sources of these facts:
- SE colophon: 'A General View of Positivism was published in 1848 by Auguste Comte. It was translated from French in 1865 by J. H. Bridges.'
- Wikidata Q12718 (Auguste Comte), P570 = 1857-09-05.
- Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/John_Henry_Bridges (J. H. Bridges): death 1906-06-15.
- Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frederic_Harrison (Frederic Harrison): death 1923-01-14.
- Wikipedia, A General View of Positivism (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/A_General_View_of_Positivism): an 1848 book by the French philosopher Auguste Comte, first published in English in 1865.
